business_summary: Foshan Electrical and Lighting Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research and development, production, and sale of general lighting and electrical products, automotive lighting, LED packaging products, and others in the People's Republic of China and internationally. It offers general lighting and electrical products, including LED light sources, LED luminaries, and traditional lighting products; lighting solutions for home lighting, commercial lighting, industrial lighting, municipal road lighting, and landscape lighting; LED bulbs, LED candle bulbs, LED spotlights, LED filament bulbs, and LED tube and battens; LED downlights, LED track lights, LED panel lights, LED ceiling lamps, LED strip lights, and LED emergency lights; and LED flood lights. It also provides electrical products comprising switches, electrical tape, and sockets; headlights, rear light combos, fog lights, backup lights, interior lights, and license plate lights; and offers smart lighting, healthy lighting, marine lighting, aviation lighting and animal and plant lighting. In addition, the company offers LED epitaxial wafers and chips, LED packaging and component products, integrated circuit packaging products, and third generation compound semiconductor packaging products. Further, it engages in property development and business services. Foshan Electrical and Lighting Co.,Ltd was founded in 1958 and is based in Foshan, the People's Republic of China.
business_summary_ko: Foshan Electrical and Lighting Co.,Ltd는 자회사와 함께 중화인민공화국 및 국제적으로 일반 조명 및 전기 제품, 자동차 조명, LED 포장 제품 등의 연구 개발, 생산 및 판매에 참여하고 있습니다. LED 광원, LED 조명기구, 전통 조명 제품을 포함한 일반 조명 및 전기 제품을 제공합니다. 가정용 조명, 상업용 조명, 산업용 조명, 도시 도로 조명 및 경관 조명을 위한 조명 솔루션; LED 전구, LED 양초 전구, LED 스포트라이트, LED 필라멘트 전구, LED 튜브 및 배튼; LED 다운라이트, LED 트랙 조명, LED 패널 조명, LED 천장 조명, LED 스트립 조명 및 LED 비상 조명; 그리고 LED 투광 조명. 또한 스위치, 전기 테이프 및 소켓으로 구성된 전기 제품도 제공합니다. 헤드라이트, 후방 조명 콤보, 안개등, 백업 조명, 실내 조명 및 번호판 조명; 스마트조명, 건강조명, 해양조명, 항공조명, 동식물조명 등을 제공하고 있습니다. 또한, 회사는 LED 에피택셜 웨이퍼 및 칩, LED 패키징 및 부품 제품, 집적 회로를 제공합니다.
